fluff.overview: The AFFS treats its infantry as professionals rather than expendable garrison filler, drawing soldiers from single worlds or neighboring systems to build the unit cohesion that the Federated Suns considers essential to effective combined-arms operations. Motorized platoons ride light vehicles that give them the speed to screen advancing columns, patrol supply routes, and respond to threats faster than foot infantry, though they sacrifice protection for that mobility. Configured for civil disturbance management rather than conventional military combat, these riot control troops are trained in crowd suppression, population control, and non-lethal enforcement operations on garrison worlds during periods of unrest or political transition.
